page: UpCloud GPU-96xCPU-960GB-4xB200 is a GPU-accelerated server configured on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 96 vCPUs and a shared CPU allocation model. The system is equipped with 960.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 10.0 GB of RAM per core.

The primary hardware accelerator configuration consists of four NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs, providing a total of 768 GB of GPU VRAM. This server does not include local storage, meaning external storage solutions must be attached to handle data persistence. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Given the shared CPU allocation and lack of local storage, workloads must be structured to accommodate potential CPU scheduling variations and rely on network-attached storage. The massive GPU memory and compute capacity make this server suitable for large-scale machine learning, deep learning model training, LLM inference, and high-performance data science jobs.
